readings.moment: When the temple struck ten (Girard looked at his watch)
Girard went out into the street
Piano started in the salon as Girard lit his cigar
Faint quick bells heard from the master's window
Girard came back into the house
Hall clock struck eleven as Girard came back in
Hall clock face as Girard came back in

whereabouts: Girard came to dinner at Monnier's invitation.
The price quarrel with Monnier took place at the dinner table, heard by half the table.
After dinner Girard sat alone in the dining room with brandy.
Monnier had everyone show their watches after dinner.
Girard went out into the street at 10:21 by his watch.
Girard stayed under the front windows of the house while in the street.
Girard was in the street when he lit his cigar at 10:29.
Girard was in the street, not in the house, while the piano played and the bells sounded.
Someone was playing the piano in the salon; Girard did not see who and cannot name them.
Girard came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch.
Girard went upstairs to Félix in the library.
Girard did not play cards with Dr Vauthier this evening.
